## Overview

Kohl's has launched an AI shopping assistant for its online and mobile app shoppers, the department store chain said in a press release, according to [Retail Dive](https://www.retaildive.com/news/kohls-ai-shopping-assistant/826585/). The assistant, called Ask Kohl's, is built using Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience, according to [Digital Commerce 360](https://www.digitalcommerce360.com/2026/08/05/kohls-google-gemini-ai-assistant-back-to-school-shopping/), and ...

editor_notes.source_verification: Read both source snapshots in full. (1) source-0.html.gz (retaildive.com, status 200, sha256 verified against manifest: 50bb8d6b...) — Retail Dive's July 30, 2026 Dive Brief on Kohl's AI shopping assistant. Confirms the launch, the assistant's feature set (deals aggregation, personalized recommendations, product comparison, image search, promotion queries, order tracking, customer-service handoff, BOPIS), the Mother's Day Gift Finder lineage and its Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience basis, the Macy's/Michaels/Lowe's (Mylow/Mylow Companion) competitive framing, the exact Kohl's quote ('As we continue to enhance the experience...'), and the Q1 financials (1.7% net sales dip, 1.1% comp decline, $14M net loss narrowed by $1M) — all verbatim or accurate paraphrase matches to the article. (2) source-1.html.gz (digitalcommerce360.com, status 200, sha256 verified against manifest: beb61fea...) — Brian Warmoth's Aug 5, 2026 piece. Confirms the July 29 announcement and use-case list, the omnichannel/BOPIS/in-store-stock-status guidance and self-service order-tracking claims, the exact Bender quote from the May 28 earnings call ('We're encouraged by the initial results...'), the NRF/Prosper Insights July survey figures (62% vs 67% prior year; 50% K-12 online vs 55% in 2025; 41% college online, lowest since 2016's 38%), and the Kohl's No. 25 Top 1000 / No. 473 AI Rankings placements — all verbatim or accurate paraphrase matches. No suspicious_patterns flagged in the manifest for either source (both null), and I found no text in either raw snapshot addressing an AI agent, requesting instruction changes, or asking for anything to be withheld from the user.
